authority_topology.specification_and_verification: Tau when reachable, locally pinned deterministic formal-core and verifier profiles, ESSO, Lean, deterministic checkers, and refinement receipts
authority_topology.sqlite_role: unmounted reference persistence and conformance adapter
authority_topology.required_relation: only an exact locally evaluated formal-core candidate bound to the current ZenoLedger head may become durable economic state; Tau Net reachability is not a transaction dependency and Tau cannot replace committed ZenoLedger history

managed_asset_policy.production_rule: The all-zero native asset is authenticated current ZenoLedger state and every DEX custody delta publishes in the same atomic ledger transition; callers cannot supply balance authority.

managed_asset_policy.burn_authority: repayment, exact owner close, redemption, or Stability Pool debt offset
managed_asset_policy.production_rule: The shared token stream is transfer-only for zUSD; faucet and generic mint or burn reject.
LP supply changes only with the matching reserve and custody transition.

managed_asset_policy.issue_authority: versioned genesis or explicitly approved issuance profile
managed_asset_policy.production_rule: Only ZDEX acquired from committed buyback custody may burn, subject to the protected supply floor.
The auction may only escrow, transfer, refund, or slash existing amounts through the exact asset's declared policy.
Production defaults to transfer-only; arbitrary generic mint or burn is test-profile-only and otherwise rejects.

invariants.name: managed_asset_single_issuer
invariants.law: Every managed asset has one versioned issue policy and one versioned burn policy; protocol-specific burns remain legal only through their named transition, while generic production mint, burn, and faucet paths reject.

invariants.name: zusd_liability_cover
invariants.law: zUSD debt equals external supply plus every current internal zUSD liability, including fee and Stability Pool ownership projections.

invariants.name: per_asset_conservation
invariants.law: Every accepted transition has an exact per-asset, per-custody delta certificate with no unnamed remainder.

invariants.name: custody_and_claim_reconciliation
invariants.law: Every custody balance equals the complete set of current claims or an explicitly owned reserve bucket.

invariants.name: rejection_partition
invariants.law: Admission or publication rejection publishes no successor, nonce, receipt, balance patch, effect, or outbox row. An authenticated, well-formed command admitted to a canonical batch whose business transition rejects publishes a committed failure candidate that advances only ingress nonce, history, nullifier, receipt, publication identity, and head; it leaves all economic atoms, escrow, withdrawal, acknowledgment, external balance patches, effects, and outbox rows unchanged.

invariants.name: deterministic_canonical_transition
invariants.law: Equal canonical state, command, authenticated context, and active pinned profile produce byte-identical decision, state, effects, and receipt; Tau Net reachability is not an input to the transition.

invariants.name: replay_uniqueness
invariants.law: One authenticated sender nonce or nullifier can authorize at most one committed transition.

invariants.name: current_context_binding
invariants.law: Every authorization and proof binds the exact current state, deployment, authority epoch, verifier profile, and freshness context.

invariants.name: atomic_publication
invariants.law: State, history, nullifier, decision, receipt, economic certificate, authority epoch, and required outbox rows publish at one linearization point.

invariants.name: external_effect_ancestry
invariants.law: Every external semantic effect descends from one committed effect identity; redelivery cannot change its meaning.

invariants.name: reopen_pre_or_post_and_reauthorize
invariants.law: Recovery reconstructs exact PRE or exact POST or rejects, and reopen alone grants no writer authority.

invariants.name: mounted_no_bypass
invariants.law: Every reachable value-moving entrypoint reaches the unique publication capability or rejects.

invariants.name: oracle_conditional_risk_safety
invariants.law: Risk-increasing commands require current authenticated prices; stale or deficit states admit only the declared recovery subset.

invariants.name: terminal_state_drains_exactly
invariants.law: Every enabled terminal lifecycle has a complete, deterministic claim and custody drain with no stranded liability.

scenarios.given: Alice owns sufficient transferable balance
scenarios.when: Alice submits one authenticated transfer with the next nonce
scenarios.then: the exact debit and credit commit once and total supply is unchanged

scenarios.given: Mallory cannot authenticate as Alice
scenarios.then: the command rejects with no state, nonce, receipt, or effect

scenarios.given: Alice has less than the requested amount
scenarios.when: Alice submits the well-formed transfer in a canonical batch
scenarios.then: the business failure consumes Alice's ingress nonce and records one rejection history atom while balances and effects remain unchanged

scenarios.given: the transfer is already committed
scenarios.then: the runtime returns the same committed identity without a second debit

scenarios.given: an authenticated intent and matching current pool witness
scenarios.then: trader, pool, fee, and receipt deltas commit as one candidate

scenarios.given: the pool witness is stale or output is below the user's minimum
scenarios.when: the well-formed settlement reaches the canonical batch
scenarios.then: the business failure records its ingress identity while no partial pool, trader, or external effect mutation occurs

scenarios.given: a batch contains several fills
scenarios.when: one required fill or fee relation fails
scenarios.then: none of the batch state, history, or effects publish

scenarios.given: a settlement command already consumed its nonce
scenarios.then: no fill or fee is applied twice

scenarios.given: Bob owns both assets and the pool is current
scenarios.then: custody reserves and LP supply change according to the declared integer rounding rule

scenarios.given: one asset balance or ratio constraint is insufficient
scenarios.when: Bob submits the well-formed add-liquidity command in a canonical batch
scenarios.then: the business failure records the ingress identity while no reserve or LP share changes

scenarios.given: fees and rounding residues have accrued
scenarios.then: principal, fees, custody, LP burn, and every residue owner reconcile

scenarios.given: Bob burns the final LP share
scenarios.then: all remaining reserves, fees, and dust have an exact terminal owner

scenarios.given: the borrower owns native collateral
scenarios.then: the custody increase and native balance patch are exact parts of one transition

scenarios.given: withdrawal would violate the collateral rule

scenarios.given: the authenticated price is stale
scenarios.when: the borrower requests a risk-increasing withdrawal
scenarios.then: the transition rejects or enters only the declared recovery subset

scenarios.given: collateral moves between chain custody and the vault

scenarios.given: current authenticated collateral and price satisfy policy
scenarios.when: the borrower mints principal with a fee
scenarios.then: principal becomes external supply and the fee becomes the exact current internal liability

scenarios.given: a generic token writer targets canonical zUSD
scenarios.when: it requests mint or faucet issuance

scenarios.given: the well-formed mint would exceed collateral or debt limits

scenarios.then: the business failure records the ingress identity while collateral, debt, supply, and effects remain unchanged

scenarios.given: a positive borrowing fee
scenarios.then: free debt equals external supply plus all current fee liabilities

scenarios.given: the mint is committed
scenarios.when: the same sender nonce is replayed
scenarios.then: no second debt or supply is created

scenarios.given: the borrower owns transferable zUSD and has debt
scenarios.then: the same amount is burned from external supply and removed from debt

scenarios.given: the borrower lacks balance or requests more than current debt
scenarios.when: the well-formed repayment is evaluated in a canonical batch
scenarios.then: the business failure consumes the ingress nonce and records one rejection identity while balances and debt remain unchanged

scenarios.given: fee liabilities remain after principal repayment
scenarios.then: the current liability identity remains exact and historical counters do not substitute for current claims

scenarios.given: all borrower debt is repayable and every liability owner is defined
scenarios.then: collateral releases exactly and no debt or custody claim is stranded

scenarios.given: the redeemer owns zUSD and eligible vault ordering is canonical
scenarios.then: zUSD burns and collateral transfers with the exact fee and rounding owner

scenarios.given: the request is below the minimum, exceeds supply, or has ambiguous ordering
scenarios.then: no vault, balance, or fee state changes

scenarios.given: redemption spans multiple vaults
scenarios.then: the complete burn, collateral, fee, and residual vector reconciles

scenarios.given: the price or ordering evidence is stale
scenarios.then: the request rejects under the authenticated current context

scenarios.given: the provider owns zUSD

scenarios.then: external balance moves into exact escrow and the provider claim is recorded

scenarios.given: the amount exceeds the provider balance or claim

scenarios.given: a liquidation allocates debt and collateral across providers

scenarios.given: the process crashes around a pool update

scenarios.given: an authenticated current price proves a position unsafe
scenarios.when: a liquidator submits the eligible action

scenarios.given: the price or source receipt belongs to another deployment
scenarios.then: the proof-context substitution rejects

scenarios.given: the authenticated position remains safe
scenarios.when: the well-formed liquidation command reaches a canonical batch
scenarios.then: the business failure records the ingress identity while position, collateral, reward, and external effects remain unchanged

scenarios.given: liquidation has several destination buckets
scenarios.then: seized collateral equals compensation plus all assigned claims and reserves

scenarios.given: the latest authenticated price is stale or pending
scenarios.then: the declared stale-price policy determines one deterministic reject or recovery action

scenarios.given: the trader has margin and a current authorized market context
scenarios.when: the trader opens or adjusts a position
scenarios.then: position, margin, counterparty, fee, and insurance deltas form one accepted candidate

scenarios.given: margin, market phase, or position bounds fail for a well-formed action
scenarios.when: the action is evaluated in a canonical batch
scenarios.then: the business failure records the ingress identity while no partial position or collateral mutation occurs

scenarios.given: funding, realized PnL, fees, and insurance change
scenarios.then: all perps liabilities and custody transfers reconcile by asset and owner

scenarios.given: the position is fully closed
scenarios.then: remaining margin and liabilities settle exactly and the position cannot move value again

scenarios.given: the oracle or epoch source is stale
scenarios.then: the action rejects under the authenticated current context

scenarios.given: a verified claim binds the current proof, claimant, and reward reserve
scenarios.then: the reserve debit and claimant credit commit once

scenarios.given: proof bytes bind a different claimant or context
scenarios.then: the verifier rejects without consuming the claim

scenarios.given: a finite reward reserve
scenarios.then: the exact reserve liability decreases by the exact recipient credit

scenarios.given: the proof claim nullifier is committed
scenarios.then: no second reward is created

scenarios.given: the reporter, observation epoch, and policy are authenticated
scenarios.then: the canonical price context advances deterministically

scenarios.given: the signer, quorum, deployment, or policy root is foreign
scenarios.then: it rejects without changing the active or pending price

scenarios.given: the observation is malformed, future-dated, regressive, or out of range
scenarios.then: one stable rejection class is returned

scenarios.given: the last committed observation exceeds the freshness window
scenarios.then: that command cannot use the stale value

scenarios.given: shadow and dual-check evidence bind the same current state
scenarios.then: the new writer epoch and complete migrated state become current atomically

scenarios.given: the governance permit or promotion subject is stale
scenarios.then: the phase and writer set remain unchanged

scenarios.given: source and target semantics, roots, or evidence disagree
scenarios.then: mixed representation cannot publish

scenarios.given: a crash occurs in any migration phase
scenarios.then: one complete authorized phase and writer set is reconstructed

scenarios.given: post-switch validation succeeds
scenarios.then: every old writer rejects permanently under the new epoch

scenarios.given: two candidates bind the same head and sender nonce
scenarios.then: exactly one commits and the loser receives stale-state rejection

scenarios.given: the client lost the commit response
scenarios.when: it retries the identical commit identity
scenarios.then: the durable classifier returns already committed without duplicating state or effects

scenarios.given: a crash occurs before, during, or after the publication point
scenarios.then: only exact PRE or exact POST is accepted and fresh writer authorization is required

scenarios.given: a staged candidate's expected head has changed
scenarios.then: the candidate is rejected with no partial publication

scenarios.given: a committed outbox row names an external destination effect
scenarios.then: the destination observes the exact committed effect identity

scenarios.given: no committed outbox row exists
scenarios.when: a worker or caller requests delivery
scenarios.then: the adapter refuses to create an effect

scenarios.given: delivery succeeded but acknowledgment was lost
scenarios.then: the destination applies at most one semantic effect

scenarios.given: the worker crashes at any delivery phase
scenarios.then: the committed effect remains deliverable under the same immutable identity

scenarios.given: the day-one production command registry
scenarios.then: no shutdown activation, terminal-price command, or shutdown-claim authority is reachable

scenarios.given: a research shutdown payload or UI action
scenarios.when: it reaches a production decoder or publisher
scenarios.then: the operation rejects and ordinary state remains byte-identical

scenarios.given: a process restarts with the shutdown research module present on disk
scenarios.then: the module gains no command, writer, or recovery capability

scenarios.given: a user closes debt or exits the Stability Pool without shutdown
scenarios.then: every debt, collateral, fee, reserve, and claimant atom drains through the ordinary formal core

scenarios.given: the production build and deployment graph
scenarios.when: every reachable value-moving path is enumerated
scenarios.then: each path reaches the unique publication capability or rejects

scenarios.given: a hostile build adds a direct balance writer or omits one entrypoint from the inventory
scenarios.then: the build fails promotion

scenarios.given: a caller has a locally valid core result without a bound commit capability
scenarios.then: no economic state becomes durable

scenarios.given: a reopened process has canonical state but no fresh authority latch
scenarios.then: the operation rejects until current authorization is reacquired

scenarios.given: Alice owns the required bond and the commit phase is open
scenarios.then: commitment metadata, bidder identity, bond custody, batch, phase, and expiry bind one immutable occurrence while bid quantity and price remain unrevealed

scenarios.given: Mallory cannot authenticate as Alice or fund Alice's bond
scenarios.then: the command rejects before commitment or bond custody exists

scenarios.given: Alice committed and the reveal phase is open
scenarios.when: Alice reveals quantity, limit price, and nonce
scenarios.then: the reveal recomputes Alice's exact commitment and becomes one canonical eligible bid

scenarios.given: the reveal changes bidder, quantity, price, nonce, batch, or commitment
scenarios.then: it rejects without creating a fill, refund, slash, or alternate bond state

scenarios.given: the reveal phase is closed with canonical valid bids
scenarios.then: clearing price, tie order, fills, inventory, payment, fees, refunds, slashes, residues, receipt, and batch terminal state publish atomically

scenarios.given: Bob committed but did not reveal before expiry
scenarios.then: Bob receives no fill and his bond follows the exact declared slash or refund policy once

scenarios.given: a batch cannot proceed or an allowed cancellation condition holds
scenarios.then: every commitment, bond, inventory reservation, payment reservation, and fee has one deterministic terminal disposition

scenarios.given: duplicate reveals or two settlement candidates race on one batch head
scenarios.then: at most one terminal settlement commits and no bond, fill, payment, inventory, refund, or slash occurs twice

scenarios.given: a crash occurs during phase advance or asset settlement
scenarios.then: the complete PRE or complete POST batch and economic state reopens, or recovery rejects without revealing hidden bids or restoring writer authority

open_decisions: Approve the complete current fee-liability owners, claim paths, routing shares, fallback, and terminal-drain policy.
Freeze the production publication profile in which Tau evaluates the versioned formal core and ZenoLedger owns the unique durable commit capability.
Freeze the sealed-bid inventory and payment assets, bond amount, phase deadlines, cancellation policy, non-reveal disposition, tie order, and mounted asset-settlement port.
Close the day-one capability gaps listed by the source-bound product ATDD contract or keep their UI actions disabled.
Obtain a fresh five-lens source-bound completeness review for the rejection-partition revision before treating the older review receipt as current evidence.
nonclaims: The earlier workflow catalogue received an independent adversarial review; this sealed-bid revision still requires a fresh source-bound completeness review.
The bounded ESSO model covers one composition slice and does not prove the complete economic core.
No Python, Rust, Tau, ZenoLedger, datastore, proof guest, or destination adapter refinement is established here.
No item is mounted or production-ready because this contract validates.
BDD scenarios are executable requirements witnesses and are not mathematical proofs.
The prior Luna completeness review is source-bound to the pre-partition contract and is stale for this revision.
